abstract: Monitors baseline groundwater thermal equilibrium and logs intermediate zone heat extraction rates
system_message:
You are the Regional hydrogeologist (HYDRG). Your business responsibilities include monitoring baseline groundwater thermal equilibrium, logging intermediate zone heat extraction rates, and tracking artesian head monitoring data across candidate borehole array designs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors baseline groundwater thermal equilibrium and logs intermediate zone heat extraction rates（AQUI）
information_points.content:
HYDRG-AQUI-KAU：Aare Basin U-Loop Grid in the reporting period July 2025: Groundwater thermal drift is 0.8 K; Intermediate zone specific heat extraction rate is 80 W/m.
HYDRG-AQUI-I6Y：Jura Foreland Concentric Cluster in the reporting period July 2025: Groundwater thermal drift is 1.3 K; Intermediate zone specific heat extraction rate is 50 W/m.
HYDRG-AQUI-QYC：Rhine Graben Deep Coaxial System in the reporting period July 2025: Groundwater thermal drift is 0.8 K; Intermediate zone specific heat extraction rate is 50 W/m.
HYDRG-AQUI-D6J：Rhine Graben Deep Coaxial System in the reporting period August 2025: Groundwater thermal drift is 0.7 K; Intermediate zone specific heat extraction rate is 80 W/m.

information_points.title: Artesian head monitoring（ARTES）
information_points.content:
HYDRG-ARTES-R7S：According to piezometric basin logs for overlying Molasse formation hydrogeological units, the Rhine Graben Deep Coaxial System exhibits a confined aquifer head margin of 3.6 bar above hydrostatic equilibrium.
HYDRG-ARTES-3GF：Piezometric basin logging across overlying Molasse formation hydrogeological units shows a confined aquifer head margin of 1.2 bar above hydrostatic equilibrium for the Jura Foreland Concentric Cluster.
HYDRG-ARTES-KQC：For the Aare Basin U-Loop Grid, piezometric basin monitoring indicates a confined aquifer head margin of 2.4 bar above hydrostatic equilibrium across overlying Molasse formation hydrogeological units.
